title: Agnyaathavaasi
desc: A billionaire's son returns after his father's death and joins the company as a regular employee in order to nab the people responsible for his father's murder.

title: Sridevi Soda Center
desc: When Suri Babu, a light man, falls in love with a woman from a different caste, his life turns upside down due to the caste system rampant in his village.

title: Raambo 2
desc: Three friends drive on a road, scared by a car following and honking at them. However, when they try to get away, an exciting chase begins as the strange car follows them.

title: Doddmane Hudga
desc: Surya, estranged from his wealthy family after being ignored by his father, returns years later to protect their land from a vile villain.

title: Rathnan Prapancha
desc: Rathnakara is a middle-class man in his late twenties who is unhappy with his life choices. One day, he gets a startling call that turns his world upside down.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Crazy Kutumba
desc: When Gowri gets selected for a dance competition, she travels to Bangalore with her dysfunctional family. During this journey, they get to know each other and iron out their differences.

title: Kurubana Rani
desc: Kencha and Rani mutually agree to take part in a staged wedding ceremony. However, things take an unexpected turn after Kencha falls in love with Rani.
